About Online Converter

Online Converter is a free, privacy-first PDF and image toolkit that runs entirely in your browser. With 66 tools covering PDF organization, optimization, conversion, editing, security, and image processing, you can handle everyday document and image tasks without uploading a single file to any server.

Our Mission

We believe document and image tools should be fast, free, and private. Too many online converters upload your files to remote servers, exposing sensitive data. Online Converter processes everything locally using modern browser technologies (WebAssembly, Web Workers, and Canvas), so your files never leave your device.

Who We Are

Online Converter is developed and maintained by Filofa Technology, a software company focused on building useful, privacy-respecting web applications. You can reach us at support@filofa.com or visit filofa.com.

Key Principles

  • Privacy by default: No file uploads, no tracking of your documents.
  • Free forever: All 66 tools are free, with no watermarks or sign-up.
  • Open & transparent: Client-side code you can inspect in your browser.
  • Accessible: Works on desktop and mobile, supports dark mode and 5 languages.
